statement: Card Type must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 3 bytes.
Key ID must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 11 bytes.
Key Data Length must be numeric and must not exceed 3 bytes.
Key Data must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 999 bytes.

Number of Receipt
Text Lines must be numeric and must not exceed 2 bytes.

Receipt Text Data
Length must be numeric and must not exceed 2 bytes.
Receipt Text Data must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 20 bytes.

EMV Additional
Information Indicator must be numeric and must not exceed 3 bytes.

EMV Additional
Information Length must be numeric and must not exceed 3 bytes.
BUYPASS determines card type and routes transaction to appropriate authorization center.
For debit and stored value cards, transaction can be stored max 15 minutes before connecting to BUYPASS.
For credit cards, transaction can be stored max 55 minutes before connecting to BUYPASS.
For all other card types, transaction stored until next Authorization or other request initiating connection to BUYPASS.
If device supports table loads, Card Type value '164' enables Auto Close in a device.
Card Type ID prints on all credit card receipts using specific abbreviations per card brand
PINless POS Debit card must be issued by a supported Debit network.
For MSR, card must be swiped at a POS device for PINless POS Debit processing.
For EMV, POS PINless transactions are only eligible with US Common Debit AID as 'No CVM' and 'No PIN Block'.
Card Track Data must be Track 2 for PINless POS Debit card processing.
Signature Debit cards must be issued by a supported debit network.
Signature Debit cards must support manual, swiped, contact chip, and contactless chip entry modes.
Receipt Text Line Data section repeats by Number of Receipt Text Lines for total variable length up to 220 bytes.
Fields in Prompt Code 902 segment are not separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields are skipped.
Site configuration data is sent to host only when a configuration change occurs at the site.
If no configuration changes occur during a business day, no data is sent from site to host.
Fields are not separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, the next field immediately follows.
Host Discount Data section repeated by Number of Discounts, total variable length not to exceed 3,600 bytes.
BUYPASS Card Type value is matched to Card Type value of BIN table to determine if Host Discount applies
Fields are not separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields are immediately followed by the next field
This field is applicable only to the card type: Visa.
Field No. 8 (Card Type) can be present from 01-99 times in the Merchant Data Segment.
Card Type must be a valid Card Type code.
In a Table Load response, host sends Card Type code multiple times instructing device which cards/features to accept.
Value 8 indicates the device must update its Key ID and Key.
Value 9 indicates the device can update its Public Key.
Code 017 indicates BUYPASS Host Card Type.
Key ID is required in the TransArmor Load Response.
Once requested and approved, Key ID must be used for all subsequent TransArmor transactions from this device.
Key Data Length is required in the TransArmor Load Response.
Key Data Length valid values range from 000 to 999.
Key Data is required in the TransArmor Load Response.
For approved TransArmor transaction, maximum length of Signing and Signed Keys can be 999 bytes.
For a declined TransArmor transaction, a message is returned in Key Data field and displays at the device.
Start Date value of 00000000 indicates the data is used immediately.
End Date value of 99999999 indicates the data is used until further notice.
Number of Receipt Text Lines valid values range from 1 to a maximum of 10.
Product Discount Amount is used by POS Device for Authorization/Pre-Pay transaction discount calculation.
BUYPASS Card Type is used by POS Device for Authorization/Pre-Pay transaction discount calculation.
Site configuration data is sent to host only when a configuration change occurs at the site.
If no configuration changes occur during a business day, no site configuration data is sent.
Card BIN Range, Ending appears in Proprietary Load Response Data, Prompt Code 904 (Host Discount Data).
Discount Quantity Limit appears in Proprietary Load Response Data, Prompt Code 904 (Host Discount Data).
Discount Program Description appears in Proprietary Load Response Data, Prompt Code 904 (Host Discount Data).
Original Signature Debit Dual and/or Single Message transactions are always processed as Credit/Signature Debit Dual Message.
For bill payment/recurring payment transactions, Card Type code 020 must be used.
Code 127 configures device to prompt for cardholder's ZIP Code/ZIP+4 for manually keyed credit card sales transactions.
Conoco Card Type internal code is '89', used only for BUYPASS backend processing.
R (Recurring payment) is valid only if Card Type is "credit" (020) and BIN is Visa, MasterCard, Discover, or Amex.
Obtaining/Maintaining the Key ID applies only to PKI Encryption and Tokenization.
Device must have appropriate Key ID before successful TransArmor processing can occur.
Key ID is downloaded following hardware and/or software installation.
Key ID is maintained upon faulty equipment replacement.
Key ID is maintained on regular update schedules.
Key ID is maintained after unsuccessful TransArmor transaction indicating new Key ID/Key needed.
Supported card types for both processing methods are Credit, Debit, and EBT (food stamp, cash, eWIC).
Key and Key ID or CA Signed Key and Signing Key ID loads must be supported when using TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization method.
Key ID is present only when a signed PKI key is being requested.
Key Data Length valid values are 000-999.
For Signing Key, Key ID element is 2 bytes followed by 9 spaces; for Signed Key, it is 11 bytes.
For an approved TransArmor transaction, Key Data maximum length is 999 bytes.
For a declined TransArmor transaction, an error message is returned in Key Data and displayed at the device.
Key ID field contains the Signing Key in the TA Key and Key ID Load Response Message.
Key Data field contains the Signing Key ID in the TA Key and Key ID Load Response Message.
In the TA Key and Key ID Load Response Message, Data Element 155 (Key ID) contains the DEK ID
In the TA Key and Key ID Load Response Message, Data Element 157 (Key Data) contains the Signed Key
Key ID is present only when a Signed PKI Key is being requested.
Key ID value must not contain a semicolon.
yyyyyyyyyyy field is zero-filled; Key ID only applies when encrypted data is sent.
Key Data Length valid codes/values range from 000 to 999.
For an approved TransArmor transaction, maximum length of Signing and Signed Keys can be 999 bytes.
For a declined TransArmor transaction, a message is returned in this field and displays at the device.
Host specials must override dynamic card tables for card type acceptance, AVS/ZIP prompting, and SAF blocking.
Default value for Card Type is 0.
Card type values 072, 075, 077, 084, 085 are Reserved.
Element No. 175 (Card Table Data) has a maximum size of 3700 bytes.
Fields in Card Table Data are separated by comma, records separated by backslash.
Records will not be split across response messages; Card Data Block should end with a backslash character.
Record content excludes the DESCRIPTION column as indicated in Section 2.2 Card Tables.

Card Table Data: Data for indicated table type; field length determined by segment length in field 2.
EMV Additional Information Indicator: Identifies the type of EMV additional information being transmitted; sourced from Host.
EMV Additional Information Length: Identifies the length of the EMV Additional Information; sourced from Host.
Card Type: Identifies card type, feature, or requested data type depending on transaction context.
Key ID: Identifies Key ID associated with encryption key in TransArmor Load Response.
Key Data Length: Length of following Key Data field in TransArmor Load Response.
Key Data: Identifies new Encryption Key and Key ID in TransArmor Load Response or Error Message.
Card BIN Range, Beginning: Identifies the beginning card BIN range to apply the host discount data.
Card BIN Range, Ending: Identifies the ending card BIN range to apply the host discount data.
Discount Quantity Limit: Identifies the quantity limit for host discount data.
Discount Program Description: Identifies the program description of the host discount data.
EMV Additional Information Indicator: Identifies type of EMV additional information transmitted in Financial Transaction request or response.
EMV Additional Information Length: Fixed 3-digit numeric field identifying the length of EMV Additional Information.
